idea-plugin.name: Code Web Chat
idea-plugin.vendor: Code Web Chat fork contributors — unofficial fork of robertpiosik/CodeWebChat (Robert Piosik)
idea-plugin.description:
Autofill markdown prompts into web chatbots (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, …) and apply their responses with one click.

This plugin is an unofficial fork of robertpiosik/CodeWebChat by Robert Piosik. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by the upstream author. The browser Connector extension and the VS Code extension remain the upstream project's work.

The plugin talks to the bundled Node sidecar, which implements the same local WebSocket protocol as the upstream editor, so the unmodified "Autofill for Code Web Chat" extension works in Chrome and Firefox.

action.text: Code Web Chat: Apply Chat Response from Clipboard
action.description: Apply the chat response currently in the clipboard to the project files

action.text: Code Web Chat: Undo Last Changes
action.description: Revert the files changed by the last applied chat response
